fresh_validated_observations.topic: ZCSH creation/redemption plumbing creates asymmetric evidence about underlying ZEC flow
fresh_validated_observations.label: PRIMARY-SOURCE MARKET-STRUCTURE / METHOD REFINEMENT / NO THESIS PROMOTION
observed_facts: The current Grayscale Zcash Trust prospectus permits both cash and in-kind creations. In-kind creations deliver ZEC directly from an Authorized Participant or AP designee to the Trust; cash creations cause a Liquidity Provider to obtain ZEC for the Trust.

As of the current prospectus, ZCSH does not permit in-kind redemptions. Authorized Participants may redeem only through Cash Orders; a Liquidity Provider receives the corresponding ZEC from the Trust and sells/disposes of it for cash on behalf of the Trust.

Jane Street Capital and Virtu Americas are disclosed Authorized Participants able to conduct cash creations/redemptions and in-kind creations. JSCT, Virtu Financial Singapore and Galaxy Digital Trading Cayman are disclosed Liquidity Providers for cash orders.

The prospectus states that cash-order liquidity-provider transactions generally occur OTC. Therefore even a cash creation/redemption cannot automatically be mapped to contemporaneous exchange order-book buying/selling.
A Basket is 10,000 shares. As of June 30, 2026 each share represented about 0.0805 ZEC, so one basket represented roughly 805 ZEC before subsequent fee drift and the announced forward split.
The September 18 3-for-1 forward split remains economically neutral and must be corporate-action-adjusted before any shares-outstanding flow calculation.
fresh_validated_observations.inference: ZCSH has a directional asymmetry in what share-count changes imply about underlying spot flow. Positive creations can be either cash-funded acquisition or an in-kind inventory transfer, including related-party inventory, so a share increase is weak evidence of contemporaneous marginal ZEC buying unless the creation mode and sourcing window are known. Current redemptions are cash-only and necessarily involve the Trust disposing of corresponding ZEC to a Liquidity Provider, so a redemption is mechanically closer to evidence of underlying disposition than a creation is to evidence of fresh acquisition. Even then, pre-hedging, OTC execution and inventory netting mean the price impact and exact execution time remain UNKNOWN.
fresh_validated_observations.matched_control: More mature U.S. spot crypto ETPs such as BlackRock ETHA permit both cash and in-kind creations and redemptions. ZCSH's current cash-only redemption/in-kind-creation asymmetry is therefore product-specific and should not be generalized to all crypto wrappers.
fresh_validated_observations.negative_control: Recent secondary premium/discount observations for ZCSH have remained close to NAV, so the lack of in-kind redemptions has not, by itself, produced validated persistent closing-price arbitrage dysfunction. Do not infer market-making stress solely from the legal redemption mode.
fresh_validated_observations.method_rule_candidate: For ZCSH, record CREATION_MODE={cash,in-kind,related-party in-kind,unknown}, REDEMPTION_MODE={cash,other if rules change}, order cutoff, trade date, sourcing/hedging window, settlement date, publication time, AP/LP identity where disclosed and execution venue where known. Treat a cash redemption as stronger evidence of underlying ZEC disposition than a creation is evidence of fresh ZEC acquisition, but never assume one-for-one public-exchange price impact.
fresh_validated_observations.decision_support: ZEC/ZCSH remains WAIT / AVOID CHASING. This is a causal-accounting improvement, not a directional promotion.

fresh_validated_observations.topic: ENA/StablecoinX is a new cross-listed ecosystem big-move case; actual fee-switch buybacks are not yet active
fresh_validated_observations.label: BIG-MOVE CAUSAL LAB / PRIMARY-SOURCE EVENT + MATCHED CONTROLS / WAIT
observed_facts: At approximately 18:40 UTC, CoinMarketCap connected data showed ENA around $0.1987, +19.72% over 24 hours and +39.79% over seven days. In the same live snapshot BTC was +0.54%/24h, ETH +0.84%, SOL -1.37%, XRP +2.77% and LINK +2.48%, so ENA's move was strongly idiosyncratic relative to major liquid crypto beta.
Historical daily data show ENA closed around $0.1489 on September 16, $0.1546 on September 17 and $0.1684 on September 18; the current price is roughly 33% above the September 16 close.

StablecoinX filed an SEC 8-K/prospectus supplement on September 17 disclosing a September 14 waiver that becomes effective October 5. It permanently removes contractual lock-up/vesting schedules from ENA held or deliverable to StablecoinX.

The same primary waiver explicitly preserves Ethena Foundation consent/veto rights over sales, transfers, lending, hedging, pledging or other encumbrance of the ENA. Funding sales require at least five business days' notice, can be purchased directly by the Foundation, must meet stated value-accretive/working-capital criteria and are expected to be executed in an orderly manner.
StablecoinX reported approximately 3.0 billion ENA in its treasury at June 30, 2026, a very large fraction of total supply.

StablecoinX equity (USDE) closed $6.20 on September 16, $7.71 on September 17 (+24.35%) and $10.19 on September 18 (+32.17% for the session), a roughly +64% two-session move after the filing window. This greatly exceeded contemporaneous gains in broader crypto-linked equities reported around the SEC tokenized-stock exemption.

Ethena governance confirmed on September 8 that the new ENA fee-switch vote passed, but the mechanism begins only after its first USDe-supply milestone. The governance analysis sets that first milestone at $7.5B on a persistence-sensitive supply measure.

Current DefiLlama data show USDe on-chain AUM/supply around $4.8B, materially below the $7.5B first milestone. Therefore the current ENA rally cannot honestly be attributed to already-running fee-switch buybacks under this mechanism.
fresh_validated_observations.point_in_time_chain: Pre-existing tokenomics reform and distribution/product narrative -> Sep. 17 public StablecoinX waiver filing clarifies that a ~3B-ENA treasury becomes legally unlocked Oct. 5 but remains subject to Foundation consent and structured sale controls -> StablecoinX financial flexibility and treasury optionality reprice sharply in its listed equity -> ENA itself rises while broader crypto beta is positive but much smaller -> weekend ENA acceleration occurs with the buyback mechanism still economically inactive because USDe supply remains below its activation threshold.
fresh_validated_observations.catalyst: September 17 public SEC disclosure of StablecoinX's ENA lock-up waiver is a timestamp-defensible ecosystem-specific event inside a broader set of earlier Ethena tokenomics/product reforms.
fresh_validated_observations.transmission_mechanism: The waiver changes the legal liquidity/flexibility of a major ENA treasury but preserves controls that limit immediate free-float supply. This can increase the listed treasury company's balance-sheet optionality without mechanically releasing all ENA into market circulation. The simultaneous ENA repricing may reflect reduced uncertainty, expectation of better ecosystem capital allocation, reflexive treasury-equity/token feedback and broader alt-risk appetite rather than realized fee-switch cash buying.
amplifiers: High ENA turnover and liquid perpetual market
Narrative linkage between ENA token value and StablecoinX treasury equity
Prior Ethena Pay/distribution and fee-switch governance narrative
alternative_explanations: Broad crypto risk-on and altcoin rotation
Older Ethena Pay, institutional integration and tokenomics news being repriced late
StablecoinX equity rally feeding back reflexively into ENA rather than the waiver directly causing both
matched_controls: BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/LINK moved far less over the latest 24h, rejecting a pure broad-beta explanation for the full ENA move.

Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood and Strategy rose after the SEC's September 17 tokenization exemption, but published same-day gains were materially smaller than StablecoinX's approximately +24% September 17 move and +32% September 18 continuation, supporting an idiosyncratic StablecoinX component.
The actual ENA fee-switch buyback is not active at current USDe supply, rejecting 'current programmatic buybacks are buying ENA today' as the primary direct-flow explanation.
unknowns: ENA-specific venue-level funding, basis, open interest and liquidation decomposition across the exact Sep. 17-19 move window has not yet been frozen.
No direct account-level evidence identifies the marginal ENA buyers.
The future size/timing of any StablecoinX Funding Sale is confidential unless disclosure becomes legally required; legal unlock does not equal realized sell flow.
The exact contribution of the waiver versus broader tokenomics/product narrative cannot yet be identified causally.
fresh_validated_observations.decision_support: ENA remains WAIT / NO CLEAN EDGE after the sharp repricing. Do not chase the move on a false claim that fee-switch buybacks are already active, and do not treat the October 5 legal unlock as an automatic dump because material Foundation consent, notice, purchase-option and orderly-execution constraints remain. The high-information next test is venue-level leverage/spot composition plus any future Funding Sale notice/disclosure and USDe supply progress toward $7.5B.
